text: １０００ねんは　いきると　いわれる。

structure.en: that it lives a good thousand years

patterns.name: 〜といわれる
patterns.span: いきると　いわれる
patterns.explanation: といわれる after a statement means 'people say that', without naming who says it. いきると　いわれる = 'it is said to live'.

patterns.name: 〜は (at least)
patterns.explanation: は after an amount gives the feel of 'at least that much'. １０００ねんは = 'a thousand years at the very least'.
